To Judge. Prv. P.R. Ramachandra Menon J. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ W.P.(C) Nos. 22160 and 22438 of 2013 ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Dated, this the 6th day of November, 2013 Judgment
texts.facts: The petitioner in W.P.(C) No. 22160 of 2013 is running a shop dealing with sale of the product by name 'Panraj', while the petitioner in other case is the authorized State distributor of the very same commodity. The grievance of the petitioners is common, in so far as the concerned respondents have seized the goods 'Panraj' from the shop of the petitioner in W.P.(C) No. 22160 of 2013 and others concerned, to whom the products were distributed by the petitioner in other case. The seizure was with reference to the allegation that the article contains 'nicotine' or 'tobacco', which is a prohibited item. 2. The case of the petitioners is that, the product being dealt with by the petitioners does not contain 'tobacco' or 'nicotine'. Reliance is sought to be placed on Ext. P2 certificate issued by the manufacturer and also Ext. P3 certificate issued by a Government Laboratory, which clearly show that the product does not contain 'nicotine'. In view of the clearance given by the State Government Laboratory, vide Ext. P3, as to the absence of 'nicotine' or 'tobacco' in the product 'Panraj', the whole exercise pursued by the respondents is per se wrong and illegal in all respects and hence the challenge. 3. A statement has been filed on behalf of the respondents, pointing out the actual facts and figures.
texts.arguments: The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that a Division Bench of this Court, vide Ext. P4 verdict dated 03.10.2012, W.P.(C) Nos. 22160 & 22438 of 2013 has held that, the enabling provisions to intercept and to proceed with further steps will be strictly subject to the presence of the ingredients of 'nicotine' or 'tobacco', so as to sustain the prohibition/ban of the product. "2. It is submitted that the petitioner seeks interference of this Honourable Court mainly relying on Exhibit P4 judgment of this Honourable Court wherein it is clarified by the Division Bench of this Honourable Court that the Circular dated 22.05.2012 passed by this respondent only prohibits Gutka and Pan Masala containing Tobacco and Nocotine as ingredients by whatsoever name it is available in Ashraf K.I vs State Of Kerala on 3 October, 2012 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131227768/ 3 the market.
